verdict.rationale: Gemini Notebook documents making a notebook public and sharing a link with anyone who has a Google account. Individual artifacts can also be shared: slide decks as PDF, infographics via a share option, and notes exported to Google Docs. Viewing is covered, but there is no evidence of collaborator edit or contributor permissions that would let others build on a shared notebook. missing for 10: documented collaborator editing/build-on permissions, private sharing with specific people and role controls, independent hands-on corroboration of sharing.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can share a research session or report with collaborators who can view or build on it

citations.quote: You can make your notebook public and share a link with anyone with a Google account.
Present your deck instantly in Gemini Notebook or share it as a PDF.
Use the three dots menu next to your generated Infographic to rename, download as a PNG file, share, or delete.
You can export your notes to Google Docs or Google Sheets.
